description: A variadic_param name in parentheses is an error
notes: The README doesn't say how params and variadic_param are read. hashicorp/hcl reads params with hcl.ExprList and each name with hcl.ExprAsKeyword (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), and neither looks inside parentheses in the native syntax (see native/analysis/list-parenthesized-tuple and native/analysis/traversal-parenthesized).
